# Pyro Studio Ecosystem - Comprehensive LLM Documentation

This file contains exhaustive specifications, feature capabilities, and technical details for all applications in the Pyro Studio ecosystem.

================================================================================
APPLICATION 1: VehereGo (Package: com.mypyro.veherego)
================================================================================

Overview:
VehereGo is a local-first, privacy-focused central hub for managing parcel pickup codes, flight/train tickets, PKPass digital vouchers, live status bar activities, universal calendars, and course schedules on Android.

Key Features:
1. Status Bar Island & Live Activities:
   Pushes real-time parcel shipping progress, food delivery status, transit tickets, music playback, and custom system notifications to status bar floating capsules.
2. Smart Parcel Pickup Code OCR & SMS Parsing:
   Auto-detects parcel extraction codes from screenshots (Cainiao Station, SF Express, Hive Box, Meituan) using on-device OCR. Generates scannable barcodes and QR codes for instant station pickup.
3. PKPass Wallet:
   Native support for Apple Wallet (.pkpass) format passes, boarding passes, event tickets, and loyalty cards.
4. Universal Calendar & Course Schedule:
   Includes solar/lunar dates, 24 solar terms, auspicious daily guides, odd/even week course schedules, and 1-click ICS calendar import/export.
5. 100% On-Device Privacy:
   Zero user accounts, zero server tracking, zero cloud data uploads.

Links:
- Landing Page: https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/veherego/index.html
- Google Group Tester Access: https://groups.google.com/g/pyroapp/members
- Google Play Beta Track: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.mypyro.veherego

================================================================================
APPLICATION 2: PyroMagma Academic AI Reader (Package: com.mypyro.pyromagma)
================================================================================

Overview:
PyroMagma Academic is an AI-driven academic literature reader designed for researchers, graduate students, engineers, and avid readers.

Key Features:
1. Immersive Academic Card Feed:
   Card-swiping interface to browse latest papers from ArXiv, Nature, Science, IEEE, and PubMed during fragmented time.
2. Edge & Cloud AI Summaries & RAG Q&A:
   One-click extraction of core innovations, methodology, and limitations. Interactive RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Q&A over full PDF text to resolve complex equations and derivations.
3. Multi-Engine Smooth Translation:
   Local and cloud translation engines provide side-by-side bilingual reading with precise technical terminology mapping.
4. Reference Library & Cloud Sync:
   Seamless 1-click synchronization with Zotero, EndNote, Mendeley, and WebDAV / Cloud storage.
5. On-Device Recommendation & Privacy:
   100% on-device preference algorithms that break filter bubbles safely without uploading reading history to servers.

Links:
- Landing Page: https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/pyromagma/index.html
- Community Access: https://groups.google.com/g/pyroapp/members

================================================================================
APPLICATION 3: PyroMagma Reader / Legado Alternative (Package: com.mypyro.pyromagma)
================================================================================

Overview:
PyroMagma Reader is a privacy-focused on-device AI reader for web novels, raw manga comics, EPUB ebooks, and academic research papers, serving as the premier alternative to Legado (开源阅读).

Key Features:
1. Ultimate Legado Alternative:
   Supports custom book sources, EPUB, PDF, RSS, and web novels in a clean, ad-free reading environment.
2. On-Device Local AI Translation:
   Local neural translation models run directly on your smartphone NPU/CPU/GPU to translate raw Japanese/English web novels offline with zero delay and zero API fees.
3. Live Manga & Image Speech Bubble OCR:
   Real-time on-device OCR extracts speech bubble text from foreign manga panels and provides instant side-by-side translation.
4. WebDAV & Zotero Sync:
   Sync reading progress, custom book sources, highlights, and notes across devices.

Links:
- Landing Page: https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/pyromagma/reader.html

================================================================================
APPLICATION 4: YourCallYourRule (Package: com.yours.yourcallyourrule)
================================================================================

Overview:
YourCallYourRule is a powerful, highly customizable Android application designed to give users complete control over incoming calls and SMS.

Key Features:
1. Blacklist & Whitelist Management:
   Create lists of allowed and blocked phone numbers or contacts.
2. Regular Expression (Regex) Rules:
   Define complex blocking rules using regular expressions for area codes, number patterns, and SMS keywords.
3. Online Rule Subscriptions:
   Subscribe to curated online blocklists using subscription URLs.
4. STIR/SHAKEN Caller ID Verification:
   Cryptographic caller verification to block spoofed numbers.
5. Dual SIM Recognition:
   Apply different rules based on SIM 1 or SIM 2.
6. Flexible Actions:
   Choose to hang up, mute ringer, or answer-and-hang-up blocked calls.
7. QuickJS Web Scraping Plugin Engine:
   Engine for scraping online databases or web APIs to identify unknown caller IDs. Includes AI automation SOP (SKILL.md) for plugin development.
8. 100% On-Device Privacy & Multi-Cloud Backup:
   Zero contact uploads. Back up settings via WebDAV, Google Drive, or OneDrive.

Links:
- Landing Page: https://choicenew.github.io/pyropub/yourcallyourrule/index.html
- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yours.yourcallyourrule
- Google Play Beta: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.yours.yourcallyourrule
- Telegram Channel: https://t.me/yourcallyourrule
- Telegram Group: https://t.me/+GHoPy6xwQEU1ZThh
